notes.title: Release Date Set: July 19th!
notes.notes:
Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan, Yuri Kissaten's upcoming free game, will release on July 19th! It's a short but powerful game about an important real-life issue, so please set aside 30 or 40 minutes to experience it.



You can learn more about the game by visiting its press kit page!



This may be an emotionally heavy game, but Yuri Kissaten also has plenty of much lighter, much cuter projects coming up in the extremely near future--stay tuned for those. In particular, our Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign for Winter Heat is drawing very near, and we'll be sharing more about it on this page soon as well.



Please get ready for Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan, because it's just the first of many Yuri Kissaten events this summer.
